## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design robust background sync with OS lifecycles, privacy, and resilience; evaluate trade-offs across battery, connectivity, UI latency.

## Key Concepts

- Native modules (TurboModule/JSC bridge)
- Android WorkManager and iOS BackgroundTasks
- Conflict resolution strategies per-record
- Data-at-rest encryption (AES-256)
- Backoff, retry, and crash recovery
- Observability: status, progress, and retry counts
- Privacy constraints and least-privilege data syncing

## Code Example

```javascript
// usage sketch
import {NativeSyncModule} from 'react-native';
NativeSyncModule.startSync({mode:'incremental', batchSize:100, conflictPolicy:'client-wins'});
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test offline-first behavior and race conditions?
- How to handle schema migrations during long-running sync?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests real-world RN streaming with WebRTC, multi-sensor coordination, and performance under backpressure.

## Key Concepts
- WebRTC integration in React Native
- Camera capture pipelines and encoders
- Backpressure, frame pacing, queue management
- Resource constraints on mobile devices and cross-platform differences

## Code Example
```javascript
function createBackpressureQueue(limit){
  const q = [];
  return {
    enqueue(f){ if (q.length < limit){ q.push(f); return true } return false; },
    dequeue(){ return q.shift(); },
    size(){ return q.length; }
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test backpressure behavior under network jitter?
- What are the trade-offs between software vs. native encoding paths in RN?
